_comment: GS-02's fixed CLAP evaluation prompt set: one plain description per preset, describing the sound itself (not just its game-moment framing). Written once, before any CLAP listening or scoring, and committed as-is - see docs/GAMESOUNDS-ENGINE.md's quality evidence section. Never edited to chase a better retrieval score after seeing eval results.

prompts.ui-click: a short, clicky user interface button click
prompts.ui-hover: a soft, quiet user interface hover tick
prompts.ui-confirm: a short positive confirmation chime, rising in pitch
prompts.ui-cancel: a short cancel or back sound, falling in pitch
prompts.ui-error: a harsh, buzzing user interface error sound
prompts.ui-text-blip: a single short blip, like a video game dialogue text character revealing
prompts.impact-wood-light: a light tap hitting a wooden object
prompts.impact-wood-heavy: a heavy thud hitting a wooden object
prompts.impact-metal-light: a light clink hitting a metal object
prompts.impact-metal-heavy: a heavy clang hitting a metal object
prompts.impact-stone-light: a light knock on a stone surface
prompts.impact-stone-heavy: a heavy thud hitting a stone surface
prompts.impact-glass-heavy: a heavy hit on glass, with a bright ring
prompts.impact-plastic-light: a light tap on a plastic object
prompts.impact-plastic-heavy: a heavy thud hitting a plastic object
prompts.impact-body-light: a light punch landing on a body
prompts.impact-body-heavy: a heavy punch landing on a body
prompts.footstep-concrete: a single footstep on concrete pavement
prompts.footstep-wood: a single footstep on a wooden floor
prompts.footstep-metal: a single footstep on a metal surface
prompts.footstep-water-puddle: a single footstep splashing in a shallow puddle
prompts.whoosh-sword: a sword swinging quickly through the air
prompts.whoosh-punch: a fist swinging quickly through the air
prompts.whoosh-pass-by: a fast object whooshing closely past
prompts.whoosh-cloth: a cloak or cloth swishing through the air
prompts.explosion-big: a big explosion with flying debris
prompts.explosion-distant: a big explosion heard from far away
prompts.scifi-laser: a science fiction laser blaster shot
prompts.scifi-shield-up: a science fiction energy shield turning on
prompts.scifi-shield-down: a science fiction energy shield breaking or turning off
prompts.magic-buff: a magical positive buff or power-up effect
prompts.pickup-coin: picking up a coin, a bright metallic chime
prompts.pickup-gem: picking up a gem, a sparkling chime
prompts.pickup-key: picking up a key, a light jingling chime
prompts.pickup-powerup: picking up a power-up item, an energetic rising chime
